study_identification_part.si4_title: Neurodevelopmental model of schizophrenia revisited: similarity in individual deviation and idiosyncrasy from the normative model of whole-brain white matter tracts and shared brain-cognition covariation with ADHD and ASD

cm1_research_objectives.reason: The study clearly states its objectives and hypotheses. It aims to map deviations from normative ranges of whole-brain major WM tracts to investigate the similarity and differences among schizophrenia, ASD, and ADHD. It also hypothesizes that WM profiles in early-stage schizophrenia would be similar to ASD and ADHD.
cm1_research_objectives.supporting_text: We aimed to map deviations from normative ranges of whole-brain major WM tracts for individual patients to investigate the similarity and differences among schizophrenia ... ASD ... and ADHD ... We hypothesized that the WM profiles of deviance and idiosyncrasy in schizophrenia, especially in the earlier phase of the illness, would be similar to ASD and ADHD.
cm1_research_objectives.location: Chien2022.pdf.md: ARTICLE section, para 2; Introduction, last para

Image quality control is described (excluding low SNR or high motion).
